subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir intended to annoy Ilvara as his entire plan.
source_quote: I'm just gonna try annoying her then.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes the moment of holding something without letting go is what he came to the monastery for.
source_quote: That moment. That is the thing I came to the monastery for, even if I did not know it when I arrived, even if I spent the first three years thinking I was there to learn to fight.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt something warm and undignified move through his chest after landing a second critical strike.
source_quote: I recall something warm and undignified moving through my chest that I chose not to name.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew he was frightened by Ilvara's psychic attack.
source_quote: The fear was immediate and specific and entirely unwanted.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood that the frightened condition meant he should not approach Ilvara.
source_quote: The spirit seems to be that I should do nothing to become closer to her.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir decided to stay where he was, frightened and grounded, because monastic training required honest application of rules even against his own interest.
source_quote: I am supposed to apply the rule honestly, even against my own interest. That is the monastic training operating at the level of self-adjudication...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt it was appropriate to say 'Thanks, buddy' to the heart fungus after taking damage.
source_quote: I said it quietly. I doubt anyone heard. It felt like the appropriate response — dry, clipped, and entirely sincere in its lack of sentiment.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not intend to remain hovering at the ceiling while others fought.
source_quote: It was not where I intended to be.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to walk up to problems and hit them with Dawnbringer.
source_quote: I am, in my heart, a dwarf who wants to walk up to the problem and apply Dawnbringer to it until the problem stops.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realized Dawnbringer was already the answer he needed.
source_quote: The answer I was looking for had been at the end of my arm the entire time.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt the heart fungus deserved a longer fight than it got.
source_quote: It had been a fine-looking icon. Big. Pulsing. Lovingly rendered. It deserved a longer fight than it got.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin intended to check on Glabbagool after the battle.
source_quote: I filed that away. I would be checking on Glabbagool when this was over.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin recognized Jorlan's cry of 'ILVARA' as something uglier and more honest than rage.
source_quote: It came out like a wound reopening. Not rage exactly — rage is clean, rage has direction. This was something uglier and more honest than rage.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin considered letting Jorlan pass because it was the sensible thing to do.
source_quote: Eight on the die. Eight says I do the sensible thing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin admitted he had no useful purchase on drow politics and heartbreak.
source_quote: I do not understand six layers of drow politics wrapped around a heartbreak, and I am not ashamed to say so.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt relieved someone else was handling Ilvara.
source_quote: I'm just sitting here watching them trade blows like a tennis match. Sometimes the most useful thing a fighter can do is stay out of someone else's reckoning.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt the insect swarm’s sound bypassed his thinking brain and triggered a primal urge to run.
source_quote: I felt the swarm before I saw it. A wall of noise, of biting, chittering fury, the kind of sound that bypasses the thinking part of the brain and goes straight to the older, smaller part that just says *run*.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum did not run from the insect swarm.
source_quote: I did not run. I want to note that.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was deeply concerned about Glabbagool taking twenty-six points of damage.
source_quote: Twenty-six points. We had not brought a gelatinous cube this far through the Underdark to lose him to biting insects conjured by a woman who had traded her dignity to a fungal demon lord.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Bahamut rewards the protection of the vulnerable, even if gelatinous cubes weren't what the Platinum Dragon had in mind.
source_quote: Bahamut rewards the protection of the vulnerable. I'm not certain gelatinous cubes were what the Platinum Dragon had in mind. But I took notes on the principle, and the principle applies.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the fallen fungal servants belonged to Ilvara, not to the party.
source_quote: We used to have so many people traveling with us," I said, "I forgot.

subject: Grygum's Revivify spell
fact: Grygum considered using his Revivify spell to bring back a fallen minion, but did not specify which one or whether he would follow through.
source_quote: If anybody is too saddened by the loss of any of our minions, I do have a Revivify spell that I could use to bring one of them back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum notes the miss of his Guiding Bolt at Ilvara without rancor.
source_quote: I note this without rancor.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum filed and appreciated the Jorlan-Ilvara drama.
source_quote: I filed it, appreciated it, and continued.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum intends to attack Ilvara.
source_quote: I am still going to go ahead and attack her.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum considers Ilvara's death pragmatic and notes the size of the spore cloud.
source_quote: Not ideal," I said, immediately. "How big is the cloud?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is glad he was standing back during Ilvara's explosion.
source_quote: I was glad I was standing back.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz's body cast Shield before his mind consciously decided to.
source_quote: That's the thing about Shield — it's a reaction, which means the body decides before the mind does.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notes the look on the Drow warriors' faces when his shield ward deflected their bolt.
source_quote: I spent a moment noting the look on their faces.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz catalogues the tactical positioning of the Drow warriors.
source_quote: Three Drow warriors. Crossbow formation. Tactical positions chosen in advance. Someone prepared for this.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes maintaining his Lolth-follower identity is consistent characterization, not lying.
source_quote: You learn to stop thinking of it as lying and start thinking of it as consistent characterization.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows what is real about his past, his transformation, and his beliefs about slavery and society.
source_quote: I know what's real. I know what I've left behind and what I haven't and what Menzoberranzan made me and what the Underdark has cost me and what I believe now, privately, about slavery and free people and the basis of any society.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes Asha's belief that he serves Lolth is load-bearing in the current situation.
source_quote: But right now, in this cavern, Asha thinks I serve Lolth, and that belief is load-bearing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz does not care whether Nym gets paid.
source_quote: I don't, particularly.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds the idea of standing in shadow while others fight unacceptable.
source_quote: The idea of standing in a shadow while that happens is — I want to find a precise word — unacceptable.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes the best way for Nym to get paid is to continue fighting and prevent everyone from dying.
source_quote: The best way for you to get paid, then, is to continue the fight and prevent all of us from dying.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz observes Nym's expression shift from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.
source_quote: her expression shifted from exasperated professionalism to something more pointed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz notices the T'sarran soldiers are having an unhelpful argument at the tunnel mouth.
source_quote: I can only describe as profoundly unhelpful given the circumstances.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds petty logistical failure aesthetically interesting.
source_quote: There's a category of failure I find almost aesthetically interesting — not the grand collapse, but the petty logistical one.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz identifies himself as an Evoker trained in Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: An Evoker — and I am an Evoker, trained in Menzoberranzan where the destructive arts were considered the only magic worth taking seriously.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes Glabbagool does not deserve the suffering the cavern keeps throwing at him.
source_quote: He doesn't deserve what this cavern keeps throwing at him.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz files the observation that the matron mother of House T'sarran will hear about the fireball.
source_quote: I filed it accordingly.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz finds that standing in the smoke of his fireball, surrounded by people fighting for him, is what purpose feels like.
source_quote: I find, somewhat to my own surprise, that this is what purpose feels like.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir understood the frightened condition immediately — and hated it with the particular hatred reserved for things that cannot be argued with.
source_quote: Zalthir understood it immediately — and hated it with the particular hatred reserved for things that cannot be argued with.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir felt the fear drop into him like a stone into still water.
source_quote: The fear dropped into him like a stone into still water.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir could not go forward and could not cross the distance.
source_quote: And suddenly he could not go forward. Could not cross the distance.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir accepted that he should not close on Ilvara and did not fight the condition.
source_quote: He stood there and accepted it. ... He didn't fight the condition. He didn't look for angles.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed the discipline of the frightened condition was self-administered and always had been.
source_quote: The discipline is self-administered. Always has been.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir found it humiliating to be frightened and unable to act.
source_quote: It was still humiliating.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wanted to know the timeline of the frightened condition — just one turn.
source_quote: How do I not be frightened? He had asked, because he wanted to know the timeline. One turn.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir realized a monk frozen by fear has no tools.
source_quote: A monk frozen by fear is a monk who has no tools.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir intended to punch the mage.
source_quote: I shall punch the mage.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted the fear cleared at the end of his turn without celebration.
source_quote: The fear cleared at the end of his turn, the way it had been promised to. He noted this without celebration.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir respected Ilvara’s discipline in speaking prophecy rather than begging.
source_quote: He could respect the discipline of that, abstractly. She wasn't going to beg.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted silently that they barely knew the dead mage.
source_quote: We barely knew you, man. He didn't say this aloud. Just noted it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama and took mental notes.
source_quote: I'm amused by the Jorlan-Ilvara drama, I thought. But I think I'm still going to go ahead and attack them. ... I took mental notes.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Bahamut does not favor spectatorship and expects action when weakness is seen.
source_quote: Bahamut does not, in my experience, favor spectatorship. ... He is more of a you see the weakness, now act kind of god.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum knew Ilvara was no longer just corrupted — she was Zuggtmoy's work.
source_quote: Ilvara was not being aided by Zuggtmoy anymore. She was Zuggtmoy's work, walking around in a drow priestess's bones.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought delivering the bolt felt like the light had been waiting.
source_quote: The bolt left my hand. ... the light in your hand feels like it has been waiting.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought the spore cloud was not ideal.
source_quote: Not ideal, I thought, immediately practical again. How big is the cloud?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was glad he had been standing back when Ilvara detonated.
source_quote: I was glad I was standing back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Bahamut gets credit for the radiance and he gets credit for the positioning.
source_quote: Bahamut gets the credit for the radiance. I get credit for the positioning. We understand each other, Bahamut and I.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum had planned much more for the fungus than he ended up using.
source_quote: Boy, I had so much planned for the fungus.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum filed away Asha Vandree’s prayers as something to watch.
source_quote: Whatever theology she was building out of this moment, I filed it under watch this space.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the T'sarran warrior’s threat was more credible because it was delivered without heat.
source_quote: A threat delivered without heat is always more credible than one made in anger.

subject: Grygum's next target
fact: Grygum wanted to find out who the matron mother of House T'sarran is before she finds out who they are.
source_quote: I'll want to remember that name. The matron mother of House T'sarran would be hearing about this. I believe I should find out who that is before she finds out who we are.

subject: Grygum's first question
fact: Grygum’s first real question after the battle was about Glabbagool.
source_quote: My first real question, once the cloud was thin enough to breathe through, was about Glabbagool.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knew the bridge falling was physics, not strategy.
source_quote: The bridge going down was my idea, technically, but I can't take full credit for it feeling satisfying. You swing at a bridge long enough, the bridge falls. That's not strategy. That's physics.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought Ilvara and Jorlan were still breathing after the fall.
source_quote: I watched them hit the cavern floor and thought: still breathing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stopped tallying the number of times the fight relocated while he was arriving.
source_quote: I stopped tallying.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt a little bad about destroying the fungus, but knew he would do it the same way again.
source_quote: I felt a little bad, in the way you feel bad about something you'd do exactly the same way again.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin admitted he was mostly running during the rest of the battle.
source_quote: The real version is that I'm a dwarf with a glowing sword in a sprawling cavern fight and at some point you stop pretending you've got angles on all of it and just pick a direction and go.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knew he could not yet tell what winning this battle cost or what it opened up ahead.
source_quote: I couldn't tell you yet what winning this one cost, or what it opened up ahead of us — that kind of math takes time.
